subject: Fix cross-module memory allocator crash by hiding wrapper symbols (#569)
reason: This is a build/link change only: the linker version script now hides __wrap_*, __real_* and operator new/delete symbols from libsearch.so's dynamic symbol table (plus a new Python integration test). Its sole behavioural effect is on ELF symbol interposition when a second module (valkey-json) using the same malloc-wrapping scheme is loaded into the same server after valkey-search. The fuzzer environment supplies only valkey-search builds (change and parent) loaded into one pinned Valkey build: there is no valkey-json artifact, MODULE LOAD is refused in command sequences, and two builds of valk
